title: Grateful Dead Live at Merriweather Post Pavilion on 1985-07-01
lineage: MAC playback, Nakamichi CR-7A, azimuth adjusted > 1 ft Lynx RCA-XLR audio cables > Lunatec V3 > AES digital out > LynxTwo in a E6400-based DuoCore 2 PC > Wavelab 5, recorded as 24/96 KHz WAV > mastering with Ozone 3 > dithered to 16/44.1 KHz using Izotope MBIT+ > CDWAV1.9 > FLAC (level 8).
source: FOB-Nakamichi 700s > Sony D5 > Maxell MX90 type IV cassettes.

ai_review.summary: Exceptional front‑of‑house recording captures an unreal, wild loud performance.
ai_review.review: The taper’s FOH capture is described as “unreal” and wildly loud, indicating a top‑tier listening experience. While reviewers give the show a perfect five‑star rating, they focus on overall energy rather than specific songs or moments, suggesting a consistently strong performance throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the show and recording enthusiastically; with no detailed breakdown, rating is high but confidence remains low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house tape described as wild, loud, and ‘nailed it’; clear, powerful capture despite being an audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set‑list comments; reviewer emphasizes overall excitement and energy of the performance.
